gold_points: Proprietary LNG plant optimization technology is licensed to customers
Payments are made at stated milestones, not tied directly to performance
Payments are recorded as deferred revenue until customer can use the license
Contract liabilities expected to be recognized as revenue during 2021 and 2022
output.note: Question is answerable from the second chunk alone; the first chunk covers practical expedients and receivables, which are not needed.
output.question: How did ConocoPhillips describe in its fiscal 2020 10-K the treatment of its LNG technology licensing payments as contract liabilities, including when the deferred revenue is expected to be recognized?
